summary: Iteration 4 tested new features: verified-domain sender email + auto-reply, admin-key protected leads/PPA GET endpoints, /admin/leads dashboard, and testimonials section on Home. All 12 backend pytest cases pass (health, blog regression, admin auth 401/200 matrix, POST /api/leads and POST /api/ppa-inquiries with dual email side-effects verified via backend log, validation errors). All frontend flows pass: KeyGate rejects wrong key with toast, correct key unlocks admin dashboard, leads/PPA tabs render, refresh + lock buttons work, testimonials section shows 3 cards (t1/t2/t3), contact form submits successfully with success toast, Joey chat launcher opens dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-reply is sent to whatever email the user submits (no email verification). A malicious actor could use this to send spam via SunMac's verified domain to arbitrary addresses. Consider rate-limiting POST /api/leads and /api/ppa-inquiries by IP.

ADMIN_ACCESS_KEY is a single shared static key stored in .env — fine for MVP but no rotation, no per-user audit trail. If key leaks, all leads are exposed. Consider moving to a proper admin auth (JWT + user accounts) before wide use.
GET /api/leads and /api/ppa-inquiries return up to 500 records with no pagination — will degrade as lead volume grows.
Frontend stores admin key in sessionStorage in plaintext — acceptable for MVP but note it is accessible to any XSS.

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test leads (1 contact lead + 1 PPA inquiry) via API using delivered@resend.dev to trigger and verify Resend email side-effects. Both notification (info@sunmacsolar.com.au) and auto-reply (delivered@resend.dev) email log lines confirmed in backend.err.log.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py updated with admin auth + dual email tests (12 tests, all pass). Environment must have REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported when running pytest (not present in shell by default — pass inline). Backend email helper logs 'Email sent to <recipient> (subject=...)' on success.
